interactive.rationale: Tables and header snippets only. document.featurePolicy.features()/allowsFeature() exists to check directive recognition live, and an interactive header rewriter (paste old header → get merged header) would be cheap — neither present.

blurb_alignment.rationale: 'How to update your headers' reads as tooling; it is prose.

edge_cases.rationale: No live recognition check, no handling for non-IWA contexts (where the directives are absent), no version guidance for the transition window.

references.rationale: Feature index links chromestatus; the mapping cites no policy definitions.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite exists; page anchors nothing.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: renders clean — 0px overflow both classes, zero console errors; no behavior on the page to exercise.
